#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 998244353;
static long long even, odd;

long long pow_mod(long long a, long long b) {
    long long res = 1;
    while (b != 0) {
        if (b & 1) {
            res = (res * a) % MOD;
        }
        a = (a * a) % MOD;
        b >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

long long pairValue(long long start) {
    stack<long long> stk;
    unordered_set<long long> seen;
    vector<long long> order;

    stk.push(start);
    seen.insert(start);

    while (!stk.empty()) {
        long long cur = stk.top();
        stk.pop();
        order.push_back(cur);

        if (cur == 1 || cur == 2) continue;

        long long half = cur / 2;
        long long rest = cur - half;
        if (seen.find(half) == seen.end()) {
            seen.insert(half);
            stk.push(half);
        }
        if (seen.find(rest) == seen.end()) {
            seen.insert(rest);
            stk.push(rest);
        }
    }

    sort(order.begin(), order.end());

    unordered_map<long long, pair<long long, long long>> values;
    for (long long cur : order) {
        if (cur == 1) {
            values[cur] = {even, odd};
        } else if (cur == 2) {
            values[cur] = {
                (even * even + odd * odd) % MOD,
                (even * odd + odd * even) % MOD
            };
        } else {
            auto left = values[cur / 2];
            auto right = values[cur - cur / 2];
            values[cur] = {
                (left.first * right.first + left.second * right.second) % MOD,
                (left.first * right.second + left.second * right.first) % MOD
            };
        }
    }

    return values[start].first;
}

void solve() {
    long long n, m, l, r;
    cin >> n >> m >> l >> r;
    long long sz = n * m;

    if (sz % 2 == 0) {
        even = (r - l + 1) / 2;
        if ((r - l) % 2 == 0 && l % 2 == 0) {
            even++;
        }
        odd = r - l + 1 - even;
        cout << pairValue(sz) << '\n';
    } else {
        cout << pow_mod(r - l + 1, sz) << '\n';
    }
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int tests = 1;
    while (tests--) {
        solve();
    }
    return 0;
}
